_note: Assembled from the Shopify advertorial export by hand (query/runbook.md Step 1). The export is not a content.json: it carries page.content, page.htmlCompiled and brief, but no product.attributes block and no reference_photos. Every attribute below is DERIVED from brief.specification and brief.personaCorePain and is marked as such — none was supplied by the source.

product.name: 7-in-1 External USB DVD / Blu-ray Drive
product.type: External optical drive with built-in USB hub and SD card reader

attribute_derivation.operation: A disc is inserted and plays; the user does something else while it runs. Sets the POSE branch to relaxed, gaze away.
attribute_derivation.visible_output: The drive emits nothing outward. The LED indicator is an indicator, not an output, and G8 forbids inventing an emission so a render looks alive — so no `output` mark is used anywhere on this page.
attribute_derivation.mounting: Not fixed-installed, so the G7-X installed mode and the ugc low-angle reframe do not bind.
attribute_derivation.colorways: One. Zone B of any 06-relief-hero shows a single unit; a second colorway would violate G2.
attribute_derivation.body_contact: FALSE, and this is the page's most consequential gate: it drops 03-mechanism-ghostbody outright and sends every mechanism slot to 03-mechanism-xray.
attribute_derivation.symptom_visibility: The symptom lives on objects — a jammed tray, a dongle knot, a scratched disc — not on a body.
attribute_derivation.result_visibility: Visible: a video playing and a desk with one cable. 06-relief-scene is therefore not dropped by the invisible-result gate.
attribute_derivation.multi_step_usage: Two steps at most. 03-use-sequence would still be admissible under its `buyers may assume it is complicated` clause — the copy leads on driver pain — but the type declares only 3:4 and 1:1 and every candidate slot here is 16:9, so it is unusable on this page.

problems_solved: A new laptop has no disc slot, so a box of wedding DVDs and home video is unreadable
Cheap external drives rattle, throw read errors on clean discs and run hot
One port means a nest of dongles and nothing left for the mouse or charging
Per-disc digitisation costs a lot and means posting away irreplaceable originals
Cloud-only storage feels one lockout away from losing the archive
personas: Parents with boxes of family DVDs and a port-limited laptop
Film collectors with physical disc libraries
Photographers moving RAW files off SD cards
Students and office workers who still need discs for software or archives

page.awareness_basis: Read from the copy, not declared. The hero spends its whole opening re-establishing that a new laptop has no disc drive, two full problem sections run before any solution is named, and copyFramework is PAS. brief.awarenessStage says `problem`, which agrees.

sections.copy_summary: First-person: unboxed a new laptop and realised the family archive was locked away.
A cheap drive that rattled and threw read errors, three dongles, and digitisation shops that wanted steep fees.
Budget drives lack vibration damping, so the laser loses tracking; thin laptops also cut power delivery when a drive shares bandwidth.
An anti-shock groove damps motor vibration so the laser stays centred; driverless on Windows and macOS.
One cable in, two USB-A plus USB-C and an SD slot out; the mouse and card reader stay plugged in.
Slim enough for a laptop sleeve, stays cool across long sessions, burns 50GB discs.
The wedding DVD played end to end on movie night; the archive is backed up and the desk is tidy.
Replaces a separate drive, a powered hub and a card reader, and avoids per-disc transfer fees.
Verified-purchase quotes about silent playback, cleared dongles and SD transfers.

known_gaps: reference_photos is EMPTY. imageBriefs and shopifyProductGid are both null in the export, so there is no product photograph to hash (SPEC 6.4). Ten of the twelve routed slots declare requires_product_photo: true. No attachment was fabricated; every option omits the field instead.

The template's placeholder image labels are from a different product entirely — a weighted blanket. TPL-ADV08 was reused without restamping them. Every brief in prompts.json is derived from page.content and brief, never from those labels.

The reviews section places reviews.shots.0-3 inside the same section element as three named, verified-purchase quotes. 05-social-snapshot's authenticity fence bars a generated snapshot from sitting beside a name, avatar, star row or verified label.
